post.description: Keeps the articles of a Google Reader JSON export, such as the starred-articles export of FreshRSS, Inoreader or Google Takeout, up to 64 MiB and 10,000 articles. Articles Earnest already has are kept; others are stored from the export. The export's labels are added to each article. The import never rewrites existing articles, never brings back an article you un-kept, a label you deleted or a label you removed from an article, and keeps imported articles out of the river.
